body_markdown:
## The Challenge


A growing regional airline operating ATR 72 and Embraer E175 aircraft needed to differentiate their passenger experience without the cost and complexity of installed IFE systems. With aircraft lease terms of 3-5 years, permanent modifications were not feasible.


## The Solution


The airline deployed **Icarus ONE portable IFE units** across their fleet of 12 aircraft. Key implementation details:


- 12 Icarus ONE units deployed across the fleet
- Zero aircraft modifications required
- Deployment completed in one week
- Content customized with airline branding
- Anna AI configured with route-specific destination information


## Results After 6 Months


32%


Increase in NPS Score


78%


Passenger Engagement Rate


0


Aircraft Downtime Days


## Key Benefits Realized


- **Cost Savings:** Avoided $500K+ per aircraft in installation costs
- **Fleet Flexibility:** Units move between aircraft as needed
- **Competitive Advantage:** Only regional carrier in market with premium IFE
- **Passenger Feedback:** “Best regional airline experience” reviews increased 45%


## Airline Executive Quote


> “Icarus ONE allowed us to offer a premium passenger experience without the multi-million dollar investment of installed IFE. Our passengers love it, and we can move units between aircraft as our schedule demands.”
>
>
> **— VP of Passenger Experience**
